gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans: Ornate and bookish, with letters that never pinch shut. Noto Sans steps in below with an open-faced c and lowercase bodies that fill most of the letter height, leaving the heading all the room it wants.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-orbit: Tight and sturdy up top, with Oswald packing its rows close, while Orbit lets every rounded character float apart below. Dense heading, spaced-out body: that gap is the whole charm.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Almendra Display has an ornate, literary hand, its letters refusing to pinch shut. Noto Sans Adlam holds its curve endings well apart, and that spaciousness is what makes the pairing click.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic reads one letter at a time, its stroke ends set far apart and its lines uniform in thickness. And Oswald above it, tight and strong, makes that measured pacing the pair's best trait.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-adlam-: Almendra Display is all ornate, literary flourish with nothing pinched shut. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined leaves generous gaps where curves meet stems, and breathing room is what the pair does best.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-syncopate: Confident and tightly knit, Oswald packs its rows close and lets the heading do the shouting. Syncopate draws with technical-pen steadiness and rung-like spacing, and that loose ladder against the dense heading is the pair's best quality.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-anatol: Storybook flourish leads here, with Almendra Display showing off a pronounced x-height. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs flicks its terminals outward and its lowercase rises almost to cap height, so extended text moves along smoothly.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic gives its small letters generous openings. Almendra Display, ornate and literary, earns its keep when it runs big and brief, where its never-pinched letters and pronounced x-height get admired.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-armeni: Ornate, literary Almendra Display leaves every letter wide in the mouth. Noto Sans Armenian brings tall, full c, s and z and inviting round letters, making approachability the pair's best quality.
gen-fs-rajdhani-fs-recia: Rajdhani is a thread of ink, no swelling or tapering anywhere. Recia, with stems that barely outweigh its hairlines, adds an authoritative edge, so the two feel crisp and quietly formal.
